what: DSWave 1.2.1 repeat mode (HW_BASE_MODE 1) setup, 75 non-cross writes
captured: 2026-11-17, usbmon on the host while DSWave 1.2.1 drove the M454 through usb-redir. 4 analog + 8 digital, 20 us/div, 1 Mpts, 100 MSa/s, auto trigger A0. The repeat state was set via the app 0x3f4/high-level mode; one setup block from W 0x01=0 to W 0xF9=0. The 4 x 257 CROSS writes are omitted.

wildcards.43: VPWM of probe 0: (voff/255)*pwm_scale + vga pwm offset, and pwm_scale is per unit (EEPROM zero info).

note: This is a recording snapshot, not a generator comparison. DSWave re-applies the repeat state at Run, and its repeat mode handler also changes auto rate/trigger/transfer (0x3f3/0x3e9/0x3ef/0x5e1/0x5e2), so a same-config baseline that differs only in W 0x00 could not be captured; that one-bit property is the driver/generator contract, not a DSWave UI property. The repeat bit here is W 0x00=0x0001; W 0x30=0x0003 is auto trigger + trigger enable. Start writes after W 0xF9 are not part of this setup block.
